title: tosk lexicon record (one line of content/{course}/lexicon/*.jsonl)
description: A lexical item: skill members (unit set) and the wider distractor pool (unit absent). Compiled into items/item_tags.

unit.description: unit that introduces the item; absent for distractor-pool items

tr.description: glosses per source language, primary first

tr_src.description: provenance of the glosses per language: a source tag (pack-format.md 11.2), e.g. wiktionary, wiktionary-pivot, claude, manual, or a pack's own data_sources id

src.description: source ids of the word, '; '-separated (not compiled)

inflections.description: inflected forms (plural, feminine, ...) used for sentence alignment; not compiled

class.description: verb class (also in the verbs record)

uncountable.description: mass noun: no plural, no number table

infl.description: inflection tables (pipeline/pipeline/inflect.py): {table: {cell: {form, stem?, ending?, alts?, wrong?}}}; tables and cells declared in course.yaml inflection_tables; compiled into `inflections`

wrong.description: plausible wrong forms that are no word of the language (distractors)
